scope: Three prespecified matched-duration, foreground, whole-device battery comparisons for the isolated Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q3_K_M harness. No shipping app or battery rating approval.
status: Completed all three prespecified pairs with fresh readiness, retained capture diagnostics, full coverage and nominal thermals. See MATCHED-POWER-RESULTS-2026-10-07.json; not a user-facing battery rating.
verification: 12 native runtime tests and nine Python power-analysis tests pass; signed Release build succeeds. Reanalysis preserves the previous complete unequal pilot and does not relabel it matched. All three ordinary matched physical phases completed; forced deadline/charging/low-battery edge cases were not newly induced.
runtime: llama.cpp b11429; unchanged native model/template/sampling pins
device: iPhone 15 Pro Max, iOS 27.0 (24A437), wireless Xcode instrumentation

phases.capture: Run-specific capture-ready.json only after xctrace explicitly confirms recording the current verified app PID; 300-second bounded gate, then 10-second settling and renewed admission check
phases.baseline: 300 seconds foreground idle with same harness open, output cleared, no model inference
phases.workload: 300 seconds: same eight fictional actual-history turns, seven 30-second reading pauses, 2K context and 256-token output cap; include full hashing/loading/generation/report export/unload. Pad remaining time with foreground idle. Inference exceeding 300 seconds requests cancellation and invalidates the pair; never truncate and call it complete.
phases.cooldown: At least 120 seconds between pairs and fresh nominal native readiness before next launch. Do not automatically retry failed attempts. Stop if user returns to the phone or eligibility fails.
phases.collector: Same 15-second inventory polling cadence throughout both phases; acknowledge profiler and wireless transfer overhead. Collect only new run reports after terminal completion.

conditions.start: User freshly confirms unlocked, app foreground, Wi-Fi, no USB/MagSafe, can leave phone alone for 35–45 minutes. Native battery >=30%, unplugged, nominal thermal state, LPM off, model present/pin unchanged. Never change settings automatically.
conditions.during: Existing memory, serious/critical thermal, foreground-loss, user Stop, charging, battery<20%, LPM guards unchanged. Keep observed brightness unchanged across every phase/pair; changes invalidate comparison rather than silently adjusting it.
conditions.trace: Time limit 12 minutes per pair after attachment; operator stops after native terminal receipt. Preserve failed traces and reports. Require full labelled SystemPowerLevel coverage of both 300-second phases and corroborating thermal/brightness/native snapshots; empty charging export is not evidence of zero charging.
conditions.analysis: Require 300 ±0.25 seconds per phase, distinct run IDs, prespecified order, unchanged brightness, no clock jump >0.1 seconds. Separate native completion/history/content/lifecycle audits from power validity. Report each pair; average/range only if all three are valid. Never select best runs or replace failed attempts without a revised plan.

limitations: Rounded Instruments whole-device battery-energy percent/hour is not watts or app-only consumption.
Workload-minus-baseline is a within-pair diagnostic difference, not exact app energy attribution or predicted battery life.
Three short pairs on one phone are exploratory repeatability evidence, not statistical or all-device qualification.
Wireless pairing keeps hardware awake; this does not measure disconnected idle/sleep.
Native battery percentage is coarse and retained separately; do not infer answers per charge.
Full model rehash/reload per turn is evaluation behavior, not an optimized shipping runtime.
Earlier sustained-use thermal failure and earlier partial trace remain unchanged and retained.
evidenceToRetain: Binary SHA, readiness/admission, run-specific capture receipt, all native turn inputs/results/markers, lifecycle, raw trace/TOC/power XML, per-pair power audit, chat audit and final three-pair comparison. No new weights, no personal data, no app deletion.
